title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion
abstract: arXiv:2611.11010v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems pay costs that research comparisons rarely measure: model calls at query time, building the graph, and removing documents correctly. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions that carry chunk-level provenance. Retrieval makes no language-model call, indexing makes one per passage, and deleting a document is a database transaction with no model calls: 14 seconds for 10% of an 11,402-passage corpus, after which the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. On a corpus of near-duplicate names, HippoRAG 2's capped synonym lists leave 565 fewer edges than a rebuild, while Lightfoot remains exact. translated_title: Lightfoot：具有精确、无模型文档删除功能的图检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）提升了多跳问答能力，但已部署的系统还需承担研究对比中很少被测量的成本：查询时的模型调用、图的构建以及正确地删除文档。我们提出了 Lightfoot，这是一种 GraphRAG 系统，其中每个实体、链接、事实和同义词边都是携带块级溯源信息的逐段落提取结果的确定性函数。检索过程无需调用语言模型，索引过程每个段落仅需一次调用，而删除文档则是一个无需模型调用的数据库事务：在包含 11,402 个段落的语料库上删除 10% 的文档仅需 14 秒，之后得到的图与对剩余文档重新构建的新索引完全一致。在一个包含大量近似重复名称的语料库上，HippoRAG 2 的同义词列表上限导致其结果比重建少 565 条边，而 Lightfoot 始终保持精确。在 MuSiQue 和 2WikiMultiHopQA 的保留测试问题上，使用相同的提取、嵌入和答案模型……
tldr: Lightfoot 是一种图检索增强生成系统，它将图中的每个实体、链接、事实和同义词边都定义为逐段落提取结果的确定性函数，从而实现无需语言模型调用的检索以及作为数据库事务的精确文档删除（在 11,402 段语料库上删除 10% 仅需 14 秒且结果与全新索引完全一致），解决了现有 GraphRAG 系统的模型调用成本和文档删除不精确问题。
en_tdlr: Lightfoot is a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions, enabling model-free retrieval and exact document deletion as a simple database transaction (14 seconds for 10% of an 11,402-passage corpus with a graph identical to a fresh rebuild), addressing the model-call costs and imprecise deletion of existing GraphRAG systems.
